<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>إنت كفو — رحلة القيم تصنع أثرًا</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/webp;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Reem+Kufi:wght@600;700&family=Tajawal:wght@400;500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<style>
:root{--navy:#0E2A5E;--navy2:#0A1F45;--gold:#C9A045;--gold2:#E6C673;--bg:#FBF7EE;--line:#E8DFC9;--red:#C62828;--green:#2E7D32;--muted:#6B6B6B}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--navy);font-family:Tajawal,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:17px;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
h1,h2,h3,.kufi{font-family:"Reem Kufi",Tajawal,sans-serif}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;color:inherit}
input{font-family:inherit;font-size:17px}
.wrap{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 18px 48px}
.center{text-align:center}
.brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:14px 0 22px}
.brand img{width:150px;height:150px;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(14,42,94,.18))}
.brand h1{font-size:46px;line-height:1.1}
.brand .tag{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;font-size:21px}
.brand .school{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.title{font-size:28px;margin:6px 0 16px}
.dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin:10px 0 8px;direction:ltr}
.dot{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--gold);transition:.15s}
.dot.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);transform:scale(1.08)}
.msg{min-height:28px;font-weight:700;color:var(--red);margin:6px 0 10px}
.msg.ok{color:var(--green)}
.pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;direction:ltr}
.key{height:76px;min-height:64px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);font-size:34px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--line)}
.key:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:none}
.key.go{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy);font-size:24px}
.key.go:disabled{background:#8893AB;border-color:#8893AB;box-shadow:none}
.key svg{width:36px;height:36px;vertical-align:middle}
.spin{display:inline-block;width:26px;height:26px;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:r .8s linear infinite;vertical-align:middle}
@keyframes r{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.topbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:48px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:800;font-size:17px}
.btn.gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy2)}
.btn.navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.btn.ghost{border:2px solid var(--gold);color:var(--navy)}
.btn.ghost.light{color:var(--gold2)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px}
.card{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:22px 16px;text-align:center;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--line);width:100%}
.card small{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px}
.card:active{transform:translateY(2px)}
.empty{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:26px;text-align:center;font-size:19px}
header.hd{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}
header.hd img{width:44px;height:44px}
header.hd .nm{font-weight:800;font-size:18px;flex:1;min-width:120px}
header.hd .nm span{display:block;color:var(--gold2);font-family:"Reem Kufi";font-size:15px}
header.hd .btn{min-height:42px;padding:0 14px;font-size:15px}
.hello{font-size:34px;margin:18px 0 8px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:16px 0}
.stat{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:18px 8px;text-align:center}
.stat b{display:block;font-size:40px;color:var(--gold2);font-family:"Reem Kufi"}
.box{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:18px;margin:16px 0}
.box h2{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:12px}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.field{flex:1;min-width:170px;min-height:50px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:0 14px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--navy)}
.field:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--gold)}
.list .it{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 2px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:18px}
.list .it:first-child{border-top:0}
.tgl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
.sw{width:54px;height:30px;border-radius:30px;background:#C9C3B4;position:relative;transition:.2s}
.sw:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;right:3px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:.2s}
.sw.on{background:var(--navy)}
.sw.on:after{right:27px}
.codes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px}
.codes .box{margin:0}
.codes h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:10px}
.codes .field{width:100%;margin-bottom:10px;direction:ltr;text-align:center;letter-spacing:4px}
.note{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;min-height:20px}
.note.err{color:var(--red)}.note.ok{color:var(--green)}
.map{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
.st{background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:14px 6px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;position:relative}
.st .n{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:20px}
.st.current{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(201,160,69,.25)}
.st.locked{opacity:.45}
.st .stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:15px;min-height:18px}
.pts{display:flex;gap:12px}
.pts div{flex:1;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:12px;text-align:center}
.pts b{display:block;color:var(--gold2);font-size:28px;font-family:"Reem Kufi"}
details.val{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;margin:10px 0;overflow:hidden}
details.val summary{list-style:none;padding:14px 16px;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer}
details.val summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details.val summary i{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
details.val .bd{padding:0 18px 16px;line-height:1.8}
details.val .def{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
details.val li{margin-inline-start:18px}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,31,69,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;z-index:20}
.modal .in{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:22px;max-width:380px;width:100%;text-align:center}
.modal p{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px}
.loading{padding:60px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 4px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}
.tab{flex:1;min-width:96px;min-height:48px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;white-space:nowrap;padding:0 10px}
.tab.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.stat{cursor:default}.stat.link{cursor:pointer}.stat.link:active{transform:translateY(2px)}
.stat.link small{display:block;color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;margin-top:4px}
.ccard{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 16px;margin:10px 0;width:100%;text-align:start;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--line)}
.ccard b{font-size:20px;display:block}
.ccard span{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.ccard .cnt{background:var(--bg);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);white-space:nowrap}
.mine{display:inline-block;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy2);border-radius:8px;padding:1px 8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin-inline-start:6px;vertical-align:middle}
select.field{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
textarea.field{min-height:150px;padding:12px 14px;line-height:1.8;width:100%;resize:vertical}
.lrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.lrow:first-child{border-top:0}
.lrow .nm{flex:1;min-width:140px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
.sbtn{min-height:40px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.sbtn.on{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
.sbtn.red{color:var(--red);border-color:#E9C3C3}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{min-height:40px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:700}
.chip.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.qrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 16px;margin:8px 0;text-align:start;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--line)}
.qrow b{display:block;font-size:18px}
.ph{border-radius:10px;padding:4px 10px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.ph.pre{background:#E3ECFA;color:#1D4E9E}.ph.post{background:#E4F2E5;color:#256B2A}
.legend{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;margin:10px 0 14px;font-size:13px;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
.legend div{border-radius:10px;padding:6px 2px}
.s1{background:#FBE3E1;color:#9B2C22}.s2{background:#FFF1D0;color:#8A5A00}.s3{background:#E3ECFA;color:#1D4E9E}.s4{background:#E1F1E3;color:#256B2A}
.lcard{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;margin:12px 0}
.lcard h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.all{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.all button{width:36px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);font-weight:800}
.ind{padding:10px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.ind p{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.6}
.sc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}
.sc button{min-height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:18px}
.sc button.on.v1{background:#C0392B;border-color:#C0392B;color:#fff}
.sc button.on.v2{background:#D68910;border-color:#D68910;color:#fff}
.sc button.on.v3{background:#2E5FAD;border-color:#2E5FAD;color:#fff}
.sc button.on.v4{background:#2E7D32;border-color:#2E7D32;color:#fff}
.sc button:disabled{opacity:.35}
.savebar{position:sticky;bottom:0;background:var(--bg);padding:12px 0 8px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;border-top:2px solid var(--line);margin-top:10px}
.savebar .note{flex:1;margin:0}
.hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;margin:6px 0 10px}
@media (max-width:420px){.brand img{width:120px;height:120px}.brand h1{font-size:40px}.key{height:70px}.map{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.stat b{font-size:32px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app"><div class="loading">…</div></div>
<script>
"use strict";
const SUPABASE_URL = "https://lbckrfdegflarhyvzttz.supabase.co";
const SUPABASE_KEY = "sb_publishable_g8X_h0f0N1hK4qbxWVm1CA_nAOdtYPs";
const LOGO = "data:image/webp;base64,";
const IDKEY = "kafu.identity";
const ROLE_HOME = { student: "#/learner", teacher: "#/teacher", admin: "#/admin" };
const TITLES = { principal: "مديرة المدرسة", counselor: "الموجهة الطلابية", teacher: "معلمة" };

const app = document.getElementById("app");
let sb = null;
try { sb = window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY, { auth: { persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true } }); }
catch (e) { app.innerHTML = '<div class="wrap"><div class="empty">تعذّر تحميل المنصة، تحقق من الإنترنت ثم حدّث الصفحة.</div></div>'; }

// ---------- أدوات ----------
const esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
const h = (html) => { app.innerHTML = html; window.scrollTo(0, 0); };
const getId = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(IDKEY) || "null"); } catch { return null; } };
const setId = v => { try { localStorage.setItem(IDKEY, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch {} };
const clearId = () => { try { localStorage.removeItem(IDKEY); } catch {} };
const go = hash => { if (location.hash === hash) route(); else location.hash = hash; };
const brand = () => `<div class="brand"><img src="${LOGO}" alt="شعار كفو"><h1>إنت كفو</h1><div class="tag">رحلة القيم تصنع أثرًا</div><div class="school">مدرسة الإمام قالون للطفولة المبكرة</div></div>`;
const dbErr = (e) => {
  if (!e) return "";
  if (e.code === "42501" || /permission|policy|row-level/i.test(e.message || "")) return "لا تملكين صلاحية لهذا الإجراء";
  if (/fetch|network/i.test(e.message || "")) return "تعذّر الاتصال، تحقق من الإنترنت";
  return e.message || "حدث خطأ، حاول مرة أخرى";
};
async function session() { const { data } = await sb.auth.getSession(); return data.session; }
const roleOf = s => s?.user?.app_metadata?.role || "";
async function logout() { try { await sb.auth.signOut(); } catch {} clearId(); go("#/"); }
function confirmBox(text) {
  return new Promise(res => {
    const m = document.createElement("div"); m.className = "modal";
    m.innerHTML = `<div class="in"><p>${esc(text)}</p><div class="row" style="justify-content:center"><button class="btn navy" data-y>نعم</button><button class="btn ghost" data-n>إلغاء</button></div></div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(m);
    m.querySelector("[data-y]").onclick = () => { m.remove(); res(true); };
    m.querySelector("[data-n]").onclick = () => { m.remove(); res(false); };
  });
}

// ---------- الدخول ----------
let code = "";
function pageLogin(err) {
  code = "";
  const keys = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9].map(n => `<button class="key" data-k="${n}">${n}</button>`).join("");
  h(`<div class="wrap center">${brand()}
    <h2 class="title">اكتب الرمز</h2>
    <div class="dots" id="dots"></div>
    <div class="msg" id="msg">${esc(err || "")}</div>
    <div class="pad" dir="ltr">${keys}
      <button class="key" data-del aria-label="مسح"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 5H9l-6 7 6 7h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V6a1 1 0 0 0-1-1z"/><path d="M17 9l-6 6M11 9l6 6"/></svg></button>
      <button class="key" data-k="0">0</button>
      <button class="key go" id="go" disabled>دخول</button>
    </div></div>`);
  drawDots();
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => addDigit(b.dataset.k));
  app.querySelector("[data-del]").onclick = delDigit;
  app.querySelector("#go").onclick = doLogin;
}
function drawDots() {
  const n = Math.max(6, Math.min(10, code.length));
  const d = document.getElementById("dots"); if (!d) return;
  d.innerHTML = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => `<span class="dot${i < code.length ? " on" : ""}"></span>`).join("");
  const g = document.getElementById("go"); if (g && !g.dataset.busy) g.disabled = code.length < 6;
}
function addDigit(k) { if (busy || code.length >= 10) return; code = code + String(k); setMsg(""); drawDots(); }
function delDigit() { if (busy) return; code = code.slice(0, -1); drawDots(); }
function setMsg(t, ok) { const m = document.getElementById("msg"); if (m) { m.textContent = t; m.className = "msg" + (ok ? " ok" : ""); } }
let busy = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (!document.getElementById("dots") || busy) return;
  if (/^[0-9]$/.test(e.key)) addDigit(e.key);
  else if ("٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩".includes(e.key) && e.key.length === 1) addDigit("٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩".indexOf(e.key));
  else if (e.key === "Backspace") delDigit();
  else if (e.key === "Enter" && code.length >= 6) doLogin();
});
async function doLogin() {
  if (busy || code.length < 6) return;
  const sent = code;
  busy = true;
  const g = document.getElementById("go"); g.dataset.busy = "1"; g.disabled = true; g.innerHTML = '<span class="spin"></span>';
  const done = (msg) => { busy = false; code = ""; g.dataset.busy = ""; g.innerHTML = "دخول"; drawDots(); setMsg(msg); };
  let res;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await sb.functions.invoke("code-login", { body: { code: sent } });
    if (error) {
      let m = "تعذّر الدخول، حاول مرة أخرى";
      try { const j = await error.context.json(); if (j && j.error) m = j.error; }
      catch { if (error.name === "FunctionsFetchError") m = "تعذّر الاتصال، تحقق من الإنترنت"; }
      return done(m);
    }
    res = data;
  } catch { return done("تعذّر الاتصال، تحقق من الإنترنت"); }
  if (!res || !res.email || !res.role) return done("تعذّر الدخول، حاول مرة أخرى");
  const { data: si, error: se } = await sb.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: res.email, password: sent });
  if (se || roleOf(si.session) !== res.role) {
    try { await sb.auth.signOut(); } catch {}
    return done(se && /fetch|network/i.test(se.message || "") ? "تعذّر الاتصال، تحقق من الإنترنت" : "تعذّر الدخول، أبلغي الإدارة");
  }
  busy = false; clearId(); go("#/who");
}

// ---------- اختيار الاسم ----------
async function pageWho(s) {
  const role = roleOf(s);
  const top = (back) => `<div class="topbar">${back ? '<button class="btn ghost" id="back">رجوع</button>' : '<span></span>'}<button class="btn gold" id="out">خروج</button></div>`;
  const wire = () => { const o = document.getElementById("out"); if (o) o.onclick = logout; };
  h(`<div class="wrap">${top()}<div class="loading">جارٍ التحميل…</div></div>`); wire();
  if (role === "student") return studentClasses(top, wire);
  const q = role === "teacher"
    ? sb.from("staff").select("id, full_name").eq("role", "teacher").eq("active", true).order("full_name")
    : sb.from("staff").select("id, full_name, title").eq("role", "admin").eq("active", true).order("full_name");
  const { data, error } = await q;
  const head = `<div class="wrap">${top()}${brand()}<h2 class="title">اختاري اسمك</h2>`;
  if (error) { h(head + `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(error))}</div></div>`); return wire(); }
  if (!data.length) { h(head + `<div class="empty">${role === "teacher" ? "لم تُضَف أسماء المعلمات بعد، تواصلي مع الإدارة" : "لا توجد أسماء للإدارة"}</div></div>`); return wire(); }
  h(head + `<div class="cards">${data.map(p => `<button class="card" data-id="${p.id}">${esc(p.full_name)}${role === "admin" ? `<small>${esc(TITLES[p.title] || "")}</small>` : ""}</button>`).join("")}</div></div>`);
  wire();
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-id]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const p = data.find(x => x.id === b.dataset.id);
    setId({ role, id: p.id, name: p.full_name }); go(ROLE_HOME[role]);
  });
}
async function studentClasses(top, wire) {
  const { data, error } = await sb.from("classes").select("id, name").is("archived_at", null).order("name");
  const head = `<div class="wrap">${top()}${brand()}<h2 class="title">اختر فصلك</h2>`;
  if (error) { h(head + `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(error))}</div></div>`); return wire(); }
  if (!data.length) { h(head + `<div class="empty">لم تُضَف الفصول بعد، تواصل مع معلمتك</div></div>`); return wire(); }
  h(head + `<div class="cards">${data.map(c => `<button class="card" data-c="${c.id}">${esc(c.name)}</button>`).join("")}</div></div>`);
  wire();
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-c]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => studentNames(data.find(c => c.id === b.dataset.c), top, wire));
}
async function studentNames(cls, top, wire) {
  const { data, error } = await sb.from("learners").select("id, full_name").eq("class_id", cls.id).is("archived_at", null).order("full_name");
  const head = `<div class="wrap">${top(true)}<h2 class="title">اختر اسمك</h2><p style="margin:-8px 0 14px;color:var(--muted)">${esc(cls.name)}</p>`;
  if (error) h(head + `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(error))}</div></div>`);
  else if (!data.length) h(head + `<div class="empty">لم تُضَف الأسماء لهذا الفصل بعد</div></div>`);
  else h(head + `<div class="cards">${data.map(l => `<button class="card" data-l="${l.id}">${esc(l.full_name)}</button>`).join("")}</div></div>`);
  wire();
  document.getElementById("back").onclick = () => studentClasses(top, wire);
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-l]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const l = data.find(x => x.id === b.dataset.l);
    setId({ role: "student", id: l.id, name: l.full_name, classId: cls.id }); go("#/learner");
  });
}

// ---------- الرأس ----------
function header(id) {
  const pre = id.role === "teacher" ? "أ. " : "";
  return `<header class="hd"><img src="${LOGO}" alt=""><div class="nm"><span>إنت كفو</span>${esc(pre + id.name)}</div>
    <button class="btn ghost light" id="chg">تغيير الاسم</button><button class="btn gold" id="out">خروج</button></header>`;
}
function wireHeader() { document.getElementById("chg").onclick = () => { clearId(); go("#/who"); }; document.getElementById("out").onclick = logout; }

// ---------- لوحة المتعلم ----------
async function pageLearner(id) {
  h(header(id) + `<div class="wrap"><div class="loading">جارٍ التحميل…</div></div>`); wireHeader();
  const [j, t] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from("learner_journey").select("value_id, name, color, sort_order, status, stars").eq("learner_id", id.id).order("sort_order"),
    sb.from("learner_totals").select("points, level").eq("learner_id", id.id).maybeSingle()
  ]);
  const body = document.querySelector(".wrap");
  if (j.error) { body.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(j.error))}</div>`; return; }
  const st = j.data.map((v, i) => {
    const cls = v.status === "completed" ? "done" : v.status === "locked" ? "locked" : "current";
    const mark = v.status === "completed" ? "✓" : v.status === "locked" ? "🔒" : (i + 1);
    return `<div class="st ${cls}"><div class="n" style="background:${esc(v.color || "#0E2A5E")}">${mark}</div>${esc(v.name)}<div class="stars">${"★".repeat(v.stars || 0)}</div></div>`;
  }).join("");
  body.innerHTML = `<h2 class="hello">أهلًا ${esc(id.name)} 👋</h2>
    <div class="pts"><div><b>${t.data?.points ?? 0}</b>نقاطي</div><div><b>${esc(t.data?.level || "مستكشف")}</b>مستواي</div></div>
    <h2 style="font-size:24px;margin-top:20px">رحلتي في القيم</h2><div class="map">${st}</div>`;
}

// ---------- لوحات المعلمة والإدارة: تبويبات ----------
const STAGES = ["الأول", "الثاني", "الثالث"];
const SCORE_LABELS = ["لم يظهر", "بداية ظهور", "متكرر", "راسخ"];
let leaveGuard = null; // دالة تسأل قبل مغادرة ورقة تقييم لم تُحفظ
async function canLeave() { return leaveGuard ? leaveGuard() : true; }
function tabsHtml(tabs, cur) { return `<div class="tabs">${tabs.map(([k, n]) => `<button class="tab${k === cur ? " on" : ""}" data-tab="${k}">${n}</button>`).join("")}</div>`; }
function dashboard(id, tabs, render, start) {
  h(header(id) + `<div class="wrap"><div id="hello"></div><div id="tabs"></div><div id="view"></div></div>`); wireHeader();
  const ctx = { id, isAdmin: id.role === "admin" };
  const show = async (k) => {
    if (!(await canLeave())) return;
    leaveGuard = null;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem("kafu.tab." + id.role, k); } catch {}
    document.getElementById("tabs").innerHTML = tabsHtml(tabs, k);
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => show(b.dataset.tab));
    const v = document.getElementById("view"); v.innerHTML = `<div class="loading">جارٍ التحميل…</div>`;
    ctx.go = show;
    await render[k](v, ctx);
  };
  let first = start; try { first = sessionStorage.getItem("kafu.tab." + id.role) || start; } catch {}
  if (!render[first]) first = start;
  show(first);
  return ctx;
}
function hello(t) { document.getElementById("hello").innerHTML = `<h2 class="hello">${t}</h2>`; }

// ---------- لوحة المعلمة ----------
function pageTeacher(id) {
  dashboard(id, [["classes", "فصولي"], ["rate", "تقييم القيم"], ["values", "القيم وسماتها"]],
    { classes: viewClasses, rate: viewRate, values: viewValues }, "classes");
  hello(`أهلًا أ. ${esc(id.name)}`);
}
async function viewValues(el) {
  const [v, ind] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from("core_values").select("id, name, definition, color, sort_order").order("sort_order"),
    sb.from("indicators").select("value_id, text, sort_order").order("sort_order")
  ]);
  if (v.error || ind.error) { el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(v.error || ind.error))}</div>`; return; }
  el.innerHTML = `<h2 style="font-size:24px;margin:10px 0">القيم التسع وسماتها</h2>` +
    v.data.map(x => `<details class="val"><summary><i style="background:${esc(x.color || "#0E2A5E")}"></i>${esc(x.name)}</summary><div class="bd"><div class="def">${esc(x.definition)}</div><ul>${ind.data.filter(i => i.value_id === x.id).map(i => `<li>${esc(i.text)}</li>`).join("")}</ul></div></details>`).join("");
}

// ---------- الفصول ----------
async function loadClassData(ctx) {
  const [c, l, ct, st] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from("classes").select("id, name, stage").is("archived_at", null).order("name"),
    sb.from("learners").select("id, class_id").is("archived_at", null),
    sb.from("class_teachers").select("class_id, staff_id"),
    sb.from("staff").select("id, full_name").eq("role", "teacher").eq("active", true).order("full_name")
  ]);
  const err = c.error || l.error || ct.error || st.error;
  if (err) return { err };
  const count = {}; l.data.forEach(x => count[x.class_id] = (count[x.class_id] || 0) + 1);
  const mine = new Set(ct.data.filter(x => x.staff_id === ctx.id.id).map(x => x.class_id));
  const classes = c.data.map(x => ({ ...x, n: count[x.id] || 0, mine: mine.has(x.id), teachers: ct.data.filter(t => t.class_id === x.id).map(t => t.staff_id) }));
  classes.sort((a, b) => (b.mine - a.mine) || STAGES.indexOf(a.stage) - STAGES.indexOf(b.stage) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ar"));
  return { classes, teachers: st.data };
}
async function viewClasses(el, ctx) {
  const d = await loadClassData(ctx);
  if (d.err) { el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(d.err))}</div>`; return; }
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="box"><h2>إضافة فصل</h2>
      <div class="row"><input class="field" id="cName" maxlength="60" placeholder="اسم الفصل، مثل: الأول أ">
      <select class="field" id="cStage" style="flex:0 1 150px">${STAGES.map(s => `<option value="${s}">الصف ${s}</option>`).join("")}</select>
      <button class="btn gold" id="cAdd">إضافة</button></div><div class="note" id="cNote"></div></div>
    <h2 style="font-size:24px;margin:18px 0 4px">${ctx.isAdmin ? "فصول المدرسة" : "الفصول"}</h2>
    ${d.classes.length ? d.classes.map(c => `<button class="ccard" data-c="${c.id}"><div><b>${esc(c.name)}${c.mine && !ctx.isAdmin ? '<span class="mine">فصلي</span>' : ""}</b><span>الصف ${esc(c.stage || "—")}${ctx.isAdmin ? " · " + esc(c.teachers.map(t => d.teachers.find(x => x.id === t)?.full_name).filter(Boolean).join("، ") || "لم تُسند معلمة") : ""}</span></div><div class="cnt">${c.n} طالب</div></button>`).join("")
      : `<div class="empty">لا توجد فصول بعد. أضيفي أول فصل من الأعلى.</div>`}`;
  const add = async () => {
    const n = document.getElementById("cNote"), name = document.getElementById("cName").value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    if (!name) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = "اكتبي اسم الفصل"; return; }
    const btn = document.getElementById("cAdd"); btn.disabled = true;
    const row = { name, stage: document.getElementById("cStage").value };
    if (!ctx.isAdmin) row.created_by = ctx.id.id;
    const { error } = await sb.from("classes").insert(row);
    btn.disabled = false;
    if (error) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = error.code === "23505" ? "يوجد فصل بهذا الاسم" : dbErr(error); return; }
    viewClasses(el, ctx);
  };
  document.getElementById("cAdd").onclick = add;
  document.getElementById("cName").onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") add(); };
  el.querySelectorAll("[data-c]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => viewClass(el, ctx, b.dataset.c));
}
async function viewClass(el, ctx, classId) {
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="loading">جارٍ التحميل…</div>`;
  const d = await loadClassData(ctx);
  if (d.err) { el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(d.err))}</div>`; return; }
  const cls = d.classes.find(c => c.id === classId);
  if (!cls) return viewClasses(el, ctx);
  const { data: ls, error } = await sb.from("learners").select("id, full_name, photo_consent").eq("class_id", classId).is("archived_at", null).order("full_name");
  if (error) { el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(error))}</div>`; return; }
  const others = d.classes.filter(c => c.id !== classId);
  const reload = () => viewClass(el, ctx, classId);
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="topbar" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="btn ghost" id="back">→ كل الفصول</button></div>
    <h2 style="font-size:28px">${esc(cls.name)} <span style="font-size:17px;color:var(--muted)">الصف ${esc(cls.stage || "—")} · ${ls.length} طالب</span></h2>
    ${ctx.isAdmin ? `<div class="box"><h2 style="font-size:20px">معلمات الفصل</h2>
      ${d.teachers.length ? `<div class="chips">${d.teachers.map(t => `<button class="chip${cls.teachers.includes(t.id) ? " on" : ""}" data-t="${t.id}">${esc(t.full_name)}</button>`).join("")}</div>` : `<div class="note">أضيفي المعلمات أولًا من الرئيسية</div>`}
      <div class="note" id="tNote"></div></div>` : ""}
    <div class="box"><h2 style="font-size:20px">إضافة أسماء الطلاب</h2>
      <p class="hint">اكتبي أو الصقي الأسماء، اسمًا واحدًا في كل سطر، ثم اضغطي «حفظ الأسماء».</p>
      <textarea class="field" id="names" placeholder="محمد أحمد&#10;عبدالله سعد&#10;..."></textarea>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn gold" id="saveNames">حفظ الأسماء</button><div class="note" id="nNote" style="flex:1"></div></div></div>
    <div class="box"><h2 style="font-size:20px">طلاب الفصل</h2>
      ${ls.length ? `<div>${ls.map(l => `<div class="lrow" data-l="${l.id}"><span class="nm">${esc(l.full_name)}</span>
        <button class="sbtn" data-edit>تعديل الاسم</button>
        <button class="sbtn${l.photo_consent ? " on" : ""}" data-photo="${l.photo_consent ? 1 : 0}">${l.photo_consent ? "✓ موافقة الصورة" : "بلا موافقة صورة"}</button>
        ${ctx.isAdmin ? `${others.length ? `<select class="field" data-move style="flex:0 1 150px;min-height:40px;min-width:120px"><option value="">نقل إلى…</option>${others.map(o => `<option value="${o.id}">${esc(o.name)}</option>`).join("")}</select>` : ""}<button class="sbtn red" data-del>حذف</button>` : ""}
        </div>`).join("")}</div>` : `<div class="note">لم تُضَف أسماء بعد</div>`}
      <div class="note" id="lNote"></div><p class="hint" style="margin-top:10px">«موافقة الصورة»: فعّليها فقط إذا وافق ولي الأمر على استخدام صورة الطالب في التكريم والشهادة.</p></div>
    ${ctx.isAdmin ? `<div style="margin:18px 0"><button class="btn ghost" id="arch" style="color:var(--red);border-color:#E9C3C3">حذف الفصل</button><div class="note" id="aNote"></div></div>` : ""}`;
  document.getElementById("back").onclick = () => viewClasses(el, ctx);
  const lNote = (t, ok) => { const n = document.getElementById("lNote"); n.className = "note " + (ok ? "ok" : "err"); n.textContent = t; };

  document.getElementById("saveNames").onclick = async () => {
    const n = document.getElementById("nNote");
    const have = new Set(ls.map(l => l.full_name.trim().toLowerCase()));
    const seen = new Set(); let dup = 0, bad = 0;
    const rows = [];
    document.getElementById("names").value.split(/\r?\n/).map(s => s.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(s => {
      const k = s.toLowerCase();
      if (s.length < 2 || s.length > 80) { bad++; return; }
      if (have.has(k) || seen.has(k)) { dup++; return; }
      seen.add(k); rows.push({ class_id: classId, full_name: s, created_by: ctx.id.id });
    });
    if (!rows.length) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = dup ? "كل الأسماء موجودة مسبقًا" : "اكتبي اسمًا واحدًا على الأقل"; return; }
    const b = document.getElementById("saveNames"); b.disabled = true; n.className = "note"; n.textContent = "جارٍ الحفظ…";
    const { error } = await sb.from("learners").insert(rows);
    b.disabled = false;
    if (error) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = error.code === "23505" ? "أحد الأسماء موجود مسبقًا في الفصل" : dbErr(error); return; }
    await reload();
    const m = document.getElementById("nNote"); m.className = "note ok";
    m.textContent = `تم حفظ ${rows.length} اسم` + (dup ? ` · تُجوهل ${dup} مكرر` : "") + (bad ? ` · تُجوهل ${bad} غير صالح` : "");
  };

  el.querySelectorAll("[data-l]").forEach(row => {
    const lid = row.dataset.l, l = ls.find(x => x.id === lid);
    row.querySelector("[data-edit]").onclick = () => {
      row.innerHTML = `<input class="field" value="${esc(l.full_name)}" maxlength="80"><button class="sbtn on" data-ok>حفظ</button><button class="sbtn" data-no>إلغاء</button>`;
      const inp = row.querySelector("input"); inp.focus();
      row.querySelector("[data-no]").onclick = reload;
      const save = async () => {
        const v = inp.value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (v.length < 2 || v.length > 80) return lNote("الاسم من 2 إلى 80 حرفًا");
        const { error } = await sb.from("learners").update({ full_name: v }).eq("id", lid);
        if (error) return lNote(error.code === "23505" ? "الاسم موجود في الفصل" : dbErr(error));
        reload();
      };
      row.querySelector("[data-ok]").onclick = save; inp.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") save(); };
    };
    const ph = row.querySelector("[data-photo]");
    ph.onclick = async () => {
      ph.disabled = true;
      const { error } = await sb.from("learners").update({ photo_consent: ph.dataset.photo !== "1" }).eq("id", lid);
      if (error) { ph.disabled = false; return lNote(dbErr(error)); }
      reload();
    };
    const mv = row.querySelector("[data-move]");
    if (mv) mv.onchange = async () => {
      if (!mv.value) return;
      const to = others.find(o => o.id === mv.value);
      if (!(await confirmBox(`نقل «${l.full_name}» إلى ${to.name}؟`))) { mv.value = ""; return; }
      const { error } = await sb.from("learners").update({ class_id: mv.value }).eq("id", lid);
      if (error) return lNote(error.code === "23505" ? "يوجد اسم مطابق في الفصل الآخر" : dbErr(error));
      reload();
    };
    const del = row.querySelector("[data-del]");
    if (del) del.onclick = async () => {
      if (!(await confirmBox(`حذف «${l.full_name}» من الفصل؟ تبقى بياناته السابقة محفوظة في السجلات.`))) return;
      const { error } = await sb.from("learners").update({ archived_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("id", lid);
      if (error) return lNote(dbErr(error));
      reload();
    };
  });

  el.querySelectorAll("[data-t]").forEach(b => b.onclick = async () => {
    b.disabled = true;
    const on = b.classList.contains("on");
    const q = on ? sb.from("class_teachers").delete().eq("class_id", classId).eq("staff_id", b.dataset.t)
                 : sb.from("class_teachers").insert({ class_id: classId, staff_id: b.dataset.t });
    const { error } = await q;
    if (error) { b.disabled = false; const n = document.getElementById("tNote"); n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = dbErr(error); return; }
    reload();
  });
  const arch = document.getElementById("arch");
  if (arch) arch.onclick = async () => {
    const n = document.getElementById("aNote");
    if (ls.length) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = "انقلي طلاب الفصل أو احذفيهم أولًا"; return; }
    if (!(await confirmBox(`حذف فصل «${cls.name}»؟`))) return;
    const { error } = await sb.from("classes").update({ archived_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("id", classId);
    if (error) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = dbErr(error); return; }
    viewClasses(el, ctx);
  };
}

// ---------- تقييم القيم ----------
async function viewRate(el, ctx) {
  const [q, d] = await Promise.all([
    sb.from("measurement_queue").select("class_id, value_id, value_name, sort_order, phase, learners"),
    loadClassData(ctx)
  ]);
  if (q.error || d.err) { el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(q.error || d.err))}</div>`; return; }
  const byClass = d.classes.map(c => ({ c, items: q.data.filter(x => x.class_id === c.id).sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order || (a.phase === "post") - (b.phase === "post")) })).filter(x => x.items.length);
  el.innerHTML = `<h2 style="font-size:24px;margin:12px 0 2px">المطلوب الآن</h2>
    <p class="hint">يظهر <b>القياس القبلي</b> عندما يصل الطالب إلى محطة القيمة، و<b>القياس البعدي</b> فور إكماله المحطة. اضغطي أي سطر لفتح ورقة التقييم.</p>
    ${byClass.length ? byClass.map(({ c, items }) => `<h3 style="font-size:20px;margin:16px 0 4px">${esc(c.name)}${c.mine && !ctx.isAdmin ? '<span class="mine">فصلي</span>' : ""}</h3>` +
      items.map(x => `<button class="qrow" data-q="${c.id}|${x.value_id}|${x.phase}"><div><b>${esc(x.value_name)}</b><span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:15px">${x.learners} طالب بحاجة إلى تقييم</span></div><span class="ph ${x.phase}">${x.phase === "pre" ? "قبلي" : "بعدي"}</span></button>`).join("")).join("")
      : `<div class="empty">لا توجد تقييمات مطلوبة الآن ✓<br><span style="font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)">${d.classes.length ? "كل الطلاب مقيَّمون حتى محطاتهم الحالية." : "أضيفي الفصول والأسماء أولًا."}</span></div>`}`;
  el.querySelectorAll("[data-q]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const [cid, vid, ph] = b.dataset.q.split("|");
    const item = q.data.find(x => x.class_id === cid && x.value_id === vid);
    viewSheet(el, ctx, d.classes.find(c => c.id === cid), { id: vid, name: item.value_name }, ph);
  });
}
async function viewSheet(el, ctx, cls, val, phase) {
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="loading">جارٍ التحميل…</div>`;
  const { data, error } = await sb.from("rating_sheet")
    .select("learner_id, full_name, journey_status, indicator_id, indicator_text, sort_order, pre_score, post_score")
    .eq("class_id", cls.id).eq("value_id", val.id);
  if (error) { el.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${esc(dbErr(error))}</div>`; return; }
  const okStatus = phase === "pre" ? ["current", "completed"] : ["completed"];
  const inds = [...new Map(data.map(r => [r.indicator_id, { id: r.indicator_id, text: r.indicator_text, s: r.sort_order }])).values()].sort((a, b) => a.s - b.s);
  const lmap = new Map();
  data.filter(r => okStatus.includes(r.journey_status)).forEach(r => {
    if (!lmap.has(r.learner_id)) lmap.set(r.learner_id, { id: r.learner_id, name: r.full_name, pre: {}, cur: {} });
    const L = lmap.get(r.learner_id);
    L.pre[r.indicator_id] = r.pre_score;
    L.cur[r.indicator_id] = phase === "pre" ? r.pre_score : r.post_score;
  });
  const learners = [...lmap.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ar"));
  const scores = {}; learners.forEach(L => inds.forEach(i => { if (L.cur[i.id]) scores[L.id + "|" + i.id] = L.cur[i.id]; }));
  let dirty = false;
  leaveGuard = async () => !dirty || await confirmBox("لم تُحفظ الدرجات بعد. الخروج بدون حفظ؟");
  const canRate = (L, i) => phase === "pre" || !!L.pre[i.id];
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="topbar" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="btn ghost" id="back">→ المطلوب الآن</button></div>
    <h2 style="font-size:26px">${esc(val.name)} <span class="ph ${phase}">${phase === "pre" ? "قياس قبلي" : "قياس بعدي"}</span></h2>
    <p class="hint">${esc(cls.name)} · ${learners.length} طالب · اختاري لكل سمة ما ينطبق على سلوك الطالب الذي لاحظتِه. زر «الكل» يضع الدرجة نفسها لكل السمات ثم تعدّلين ما يلزم.</p>
    <div class="legend">${SCORE_LABELS.map((s, i) => `<div class="s${i + 1}">${i + 1}<br>${s}</div>`).join("")}</div>
    ${learners.length ? learners.map(L => `<div class="lcard" data-lc="${L.id}"><h3>${esc(L.name)}<span class="all">الكل:${[1, 2, 3, 4].map(v => `<button data-all="${v}">${v}</button>`).join("")}</span></h3>
      ${inds.map(i => `<div class="ind"><p>${esc(i.text)}</p><div class="sc" data-k="${L.id}|${i.id}">${[1, 2, 3, 4].map(v => `<button class="v${v}${scores[L.id + "|" + i.id] === v ? " on" : ""}" data-v="${v}"${canRate(L, i) ? "" : " disabled"}>${v}</button>`).join("")}</div>${canRate(L, i) ? "" : '<p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 0">لا يوجد قياس قبلي لهذه السمة</p>'}</div>`).join("")}</div>`).join("")
      : `<div class="empty">لا يوجد طلاب بحاجة إلى هذا القياس</div>`}
    ${learners.length ? `<div class="savebar"><div class="note" id="sNote"></div><button class="btn navy" id="save">حفظ الورقة</button></div>` : ""}`;
  document.getElementById("back").onclick = async () => { if (await canLeave()) { leaveGuard = null; viewRate(el, ctx); } };
  const total = () => learners.reduce((n, L) => n + inds.filter(i => canRate(L, i)).length, 0);
  const status = () => { const s = document.getElementById("sNote"); if (s) { const n = Object.keys(scores).length; s.className = "note"; s.textContent = `${n} من ${total()} درجة`; } };
  status();
  const setScore = (k, v) => {
    scores[k] = v; dirty = true;
    el.querySelectorAll(`[data-k="${k}"] button`).forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("on", +b.dataset.v === v));
  };
  el.querySelectorAll(".sc button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { setScore(b.parentElement.dataset.k, +b.dataset.v); status(); });
  el.querySelectorAll("[data-all]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const card = b.closest("[data-lc]"), L = lmap.get(card.dataset.lc);
    inds.filter(i => canRate(L, i)).forEach(i => setScore(L.id + "|" + i.id, +b.dataset.all)); status();
  });
  const sv = document.getElementById("save");
  if (sv) sv.onclick = async () => {
    const items = Object.entries(scores).map(([k, score]) => { const [learner_id, indicator_id] = k.split("|"); return { learner_id, indicator_id, score }; });
    const n = document.getElementById("sNote");
    if (!items.length) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = "لم تُختر أي درجة"; return; }
    sv.disabled = true; n.className = "note"; n.textContent = "جارٍ الحفظ…";
    const { data: cnt, error } = await sb.rpc("save_ratings", { p_staff: ctx.id.id, p_phase: phase, p_items: items });
    sv.disabled = false;
    if (error) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = dbErr(error); return; }
    dirty = false;
    n.className = "note ok"; n.textContent = `✓ حُفظت ${cnt ?? items.length} درجة`;
  };
}

// ---------- لوحة الإدارة ----------
function pageAdmin(id) {
  dashboard(id, [["home", "الرئيسية"], ["classes", "الفصول"], ["rate", "تقييم القيم"]],
    { home: viewAdminHome, classes: viewClasses, rate: viewRate }, "home");
  hello(`أهلًا ${esc(id.name)}`);
}
async function viewAdminHome(el, ctx) {
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="stats"><div class="stat link" data-go="classes"><b id="sC">…</b>الفصول<small>عرض ›</small></div><div class="stat link" data-go="classes"><b id="sL">…</b>المتعلمون<small>عرض ›</small></div><div class="stat"><b id="sT">…</b>المعلمات النشطات</div></div>
    <div class="box"><h2>المعلمات</h2>
      <div class="row"><input class="field" id="tName" placeholder="اسم المعلمة" maxlength="80"><button class="btn gold" id="tAdd">إضافة معلمة</button></div>
      <div class="note" id="tNote"></div><div class="list" id="tList"></div></div>
    <h2 style="font-size:26px;margin:22px 0 12px">رموز الدخول</h2>
    <div class="codes">${[["student","رمز الطلاب"],["teacher","رمز المعلمات"],["admin","رمز الإدارة"]].map(([k, n]) => `
      <div class="box" data-t="${k}"><h3>${n}</h3>
        <input class="field" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*" maxlength="10" placeholder="الرمز الجديد" data-a autocomplete="off">
        <input class="field" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*" maxlength="10" placeholder="تأكيد الرمز" data-b autocomplete="off">
        <button class="btn navy" style="width:100%" data-go disabled>تغيير الرمز</button><div class="note"></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
  el.querySelectorAll("[data-go].stat").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => ctx.go("classes"));
  loadCounts(); loadTeachers();
  document.getElementById("tAdd").onclick = addTeacher;
  document.getElementById("tName").onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") addTeacher(); };
  el.querySelectorAll(".codes [data-t]").forEach(box => {
    const a = box.querySelector("[data-a]"), b = box.querySelector("[data-b]"), btn = box.querySelector("[data-go]"), note = box.querySelector(".note");
    const toLatin = s => s.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, d => "٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩".indexOf(d)).replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10);
    const check = () => { a.value = toLatin(a.value); b.value = toLatin(b.value); btn.disabled = !(a.value.length >= 6 && a.value === b.value); };
    a.oninput = check; b.oninput = check;
    btn.onclick = async () => {
      if (!(await confirmBox("سيخرج كل من دخل بالرمز القديم، هل أنت متأكدة؟"))) return;
      btn.disabled = true; note.className = "note"; note.textContent = "جارٍ التغيير…";
      const { data, error } = await sb.functions.invoke("change-code", { body: { target: box.dataset.t, new_code: a.value } });
      if (error) { let m = "تعذّر تغيير الرمز"; try { const j = await error.context.json(); if (j?.error) m = j.error; } catch {} note.className = "note err"; note.textContent = m; }
      else { note.className = "note ok"; note.textContent = data?.message || "تم تغيير الرمز"; }
      a.value = ""; b.value = ""; check();
    };
  });
}

async function loadCounts() {
  const c = (t, f) => f(sb.from(t).select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }));
  const [a, b, t] = await Promise.all([
    c("classes", q => q.is("archived_at", null)),
    c("learners", q => q.is("archived_at", null)),
    c("staff", q => q.eq("role", "teacher").eq("active", true))
  ]);
  document.getElementById("sC").textContent = a.error ? "—" : a.count;
  document.getElementById("sL").textContent = b.error ? "—" : b.count;
  document.getElementById("sT").textContent = t.error ? "—" : t.count;
}
async function loadTeachers() {
  const list = document.getElementById("tList");
  const { data, error } = await sb.from("staff").select("id, full_name, active").eq("role", "teacher").order("full_name");
  if (error) { list.innerHTML = `<div class="note err">${esc(dbErr(error))}</div>`; return; }
  if (!data.length) { list.innerHTML = `<div class="note">لم تُضَف معلمات بعد</div>`; return; }
  list.innerHTML = data.map(t => `<div class="it"><span>${esc(t.full_name)}</span><button class="tgl" data-s="${t.id}" data-on="${t.active ? 1 : 0}"><span>${t.active ? "نشطة" : "موقوفة"}</span><span class="sw${t.active ? " on" : ""}"></span></button></div>`).join("");
  list.querySelectorAll("[data-s]").forEach(b => b.onclick = async () => {
    const on = b.dataset.on !== "1";
    b.disabled = true;
    const { error } = await sb.from("staff").update({ active: on }).eq("id", b.dataset.s);
    const n = document.getElementById("tNote");
    if (error) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = dbErr(error); b.disabled = false; return; }
    n.textContent = ""; loadTeachers(); loadCounts();
  });
}
async function addTeacher() {
  const inp = document.getElementById("tName"), n = document.getElementById("tNote"), btn = document.getElementById("tAdd");
  const name = inp.value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 80) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = "الاسم من 2 إلى 80 حرفًا"; return; }
  btn.disabled = true;
  const { error } = await sb.from("staff").insert({ full_name: name, title: "teacher", role: "teacher" });
  btn.disabled = false;
  if (error) { n.className = "note err"; n.textContent = dbErr(error); return; }
  inp.value = ""; n.className = "note ok"; n.textContent = "تمت إضافة المعلمة"; loadTeachers(); loadCounts();
}

// ---------- الحارس والتوجيه ----------
async function identityStillExists(id) {
  const t = id.role === "student" ? "learners" : "staff";
  const { data, error } = await sb.from(t).select("id").eq("id", id.id).maybeSingle();
  if (error) return true; // لا نمسح الهوية بسبب انقطاع مؤقت
  return !!data;
}
async function route() {
  if (!sb) return;
  leaveGuard = null;
  const hash = location.hash || "#/";
  let s; try { s = await session(); } catch { s = null; }
  const role = roleOf(s);
  if (!s || !role) { if (s) { try { await sb.auth.signOut(); } catch {} } clearId(); return pageLogin(); }
  let id = getId();
  if (id && id.role !== role) { clearId(); id = null; }
  if (hash === "#/" || hash === "") return go(id ? ROLE_HOME[role] : "#/who");
  if (hash === "#/who") return pageWho(s);
  if (!id) return go("#/who");
  if (ROLE_HOME[role] !== hash) return go(ROLE_HOME[role]);
  if (!(await identityStillExists(id))) { clearId(); return go("#/who"); }
  if (role === "student") return pageLearner(id);
  if (role === "teacher") return pageTeacher(id);
  return pageAdmin(id);
}
window.addEventListener("hashchange", route);
if (sb) route();
</script>
</body>
</html>
